key_insight: Adding reason tags to human trajectory preferences helps reward models capture both preferred behaviors and the rationale behind them.
engineering_relevance: Combining learned human rewards with environment rewards offers a way to balance task performance with human expectations and safety preferences.
method: Collect trajectory-level preference labels and reason tags explaining those preferences.
Train a human reward model using both preference and reason supervision.
Optimize the policy with a combination of human and environment rewards.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved interpretability and human alignment over preference-only learning but provides no benchmarks, sample sizes, or quantitative results.
watch_item: Deployment requires validating reason-tag consistency and tuning the balance between human and environment rewards.
paper_title: Reason-guided Human Reward Modeling for Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
